summary: Through-road kerb with houses behind and no cars parked along it.

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings on the west side within about 10-25 m; golf course across the road.

drivers.traffic: Through route with lane markings and a junction at the north end; moving traffic.
drivers.convention: No signs; no cars parked along this kerb in either image.

flags: House 8 m from kerb at 88 m
sun_shade: Open on the west kerb; trees opposite shade the road from the east in the morning.

best_section.where: west kerb at the south end, beside the large shed roof
